gloss: to spout; to gush; to erupt

definitions.gloss: to spout; to gush; to spray
definitions.explanation: For liquid, steam, or gas to burst out forcefully from an opening or source.
For a volcano to discharge lava, ash, or gas. Also used figuratively for emotions or situations that burst out uncontrollably.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{噴|ふ}き{出|だ}した→噴き出す：29265_fukidasu⟧。
⟦{蒸気|じょうき}→蒸気：04278_jouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧やかん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{勢|いきお}いよく→勢いよく：26093_ikioiyoku⟧{噴|ふ}いて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Steam is spouting forcefully from the spout of the kettle.

notes:
A godan verb describing the forceful ejection of liquid, gas, or lava. Distinguished from the homophone ⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧ (to blow) by focusing on liquid or molten substances rather than air or wind.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Both (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ and ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)
- Intransitive: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{噴|ふ}く (water gushes)
- Transitive: ⟦{潮|しお}→潮：13369_shio⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{噴|ふ}く (to spout water)

ASPECT (ている):
- {噴|ふ}いて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: is currently spouting/erupting (ongoing action)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{潮|しお}→潮：13369_shio⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{噴|ふ}く: to spout water (whales)
- ⟦{蒸気|じょうき}→蒸気：04278_jouki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{噴|ふ}く: to vent steam
- ⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{噴|ふ}く: to spew fire
- ⟦{噴|ふ}き{出|だ}す→噴き出す：29265_fukidasu⟧: to gush out, to spew forth (compound verb)
- {噴|ふ}き{上|あ}げる: to spout upward

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧: to blow — used for wind, breath, and musical instruments; never for liquids
- ⟦{噴出|ふんしゅつ}→噴出：18287_funshutsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to erupt, to gush — more formal and used in scientific or news contexts
